title: Samsung puts its HBM developer in charge of memory as AI demand sets the agenda
summary: Samsung Electronics named Sang Joon Hwang, who led DRAM and high-bandwidth memory development, as president and head of its memory business, and made Won-Joon Choi head of the Mobile eXperience division. Sangyeun Cho took System LSI and Jong Myeong Lee became chief technology officer of the chip division, while co-chief executives Young Hyun Jun and TM Roh kept their roles. The reshuffle followed record earnings driven by AI memory demand and came in a week when Samsung reportedly paused some China shipments under new US rules.
